summary_md: **Alex lan ([@Alexlannmi](https://x.com/Alexlannmi/status/2115419224571265252))** summarizes the preprint **"Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting"**: agents plateau when anchored to their past attempts, and restarting from the best candidate while discarding search history can do better at the same compute. His takeaway — agent memory needs an eviction strategy.
relevance: Counter-intuitive cognition result: strategic forgetting can unlock further discovery.
